notes: Hard (total 18). Five subsystems of a compiler/runtime toolchain must each be repaired and then generalize: (1) the call-site grouper keys traces by the top three innermost frames and must reproduce exact top-10 counts on hidden traces including <3-frame samples; (2) an RLE free-space GC sweep has an introduced off-by-one that must be located by reasoning about the sweep path (hard floor, debugging_ambiguity/reasoning_depth 3); (3) a template using a post-C++11 relaxed-constexpr body must be ported to strict C++11 while keeping constexpr sums exact; (4) the mkbin tool must assemble emitted IR, link it against a project shared library and produce a runnable executable validated on hidden IR/lib pairs; (5) the ELF section/symbol resolver must parse section headers and resolve names through the symbol string table exactly. The resolver runs on ELFs produced by the IR build stage, hence dependent_stages 2. Hidden generalization is exercised across all modules (hidden traces, randomized+adversarial sweep heaps, hidden static_assert packs, three hidden IR/lib cases, and extra ELF samples); correctness must be byte/line exact. All components are lean (no real compiler bootstrap, no full OS install, no hypervisor): they exercise the same competency slivers through small C/C++/ELF programs.
